title: fix(spec): dropped-refinements census walks every reachable node instead of stopping at depth 14
body:

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DDypKu7B9nwbu5WuV7AEio8)_

Fixes #34442

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感:构建时的"被丢弃规则"清点改为走遍每一层,发布的三个已安装包结构文件多列出了它们原先漏报的校验规则。
- 属于规格工具链的完整性收口,替所有依赖已发布结构文件的作者与 AI 解决"清单说齐了其实没齐"的问题。
- 出错时构建会直接报错并点名哪个结构、哪条路径,不再悄悄截断;可整个撤回此 PR,不影响任何运行时行为。
- 无。

## What changes

The dropped-refinements census (`packages/spec/scripts/lib/dropped-refinements.ts`) stopped descending at `MAX_DEPTH = 14` and still printed "all declared". It now follows the card's Expected ruling verbatim: "The census either walks every reachable schema node, with cycles guarded by identity rather than by a depth cap, or fails loudly when it hits the cap, so that \"all declared\" is never a false complete." It does both:

- The walk has no depth cap. The identity-keyed `visited` set it already carried is what terminates it; every node is queued at most once per export.
- `RUNAWAY_WALK_DEPTH = 256` is not a cap but a refusal: a path that long means the identity guard failed (e.g. a `lazy` getter building a fresh node per call), and the census throws naming the export and path instead of returning a short list.
- The proxy-unwrap loop in `identityOf` reused `MAX_DEPTH`; it now has its own `MAX_PROXY_HOPS` (same value, a prototype-chain bound, not a graph bound).

### Measured site counts (acceptance item 1), every published schema, `gen:schema`, base f72f3353 vs this branch

| Walk | dropped sites | schemas with drops | projected sites | undecidable |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| depth 14 (base) | 1225 | 281 | 812 | 0 |
| unbounded, identity-guarded | 1239 | 281 | 830 | 0 |

+14 dropped (all in three installed-package envelopes, no new schema), +18 projected. Ledger rows added (acceptance item 2):

- `api/InstalledPackageAtEitherStage` (+1): `options[1].manifest.translations.element.valueType.flows.valueType.records.valueType.fields.valueType` (the card's `flows.records.fields.valueType`).
- `api/GetInstalledPackageResponse` (+5): `translations…flows.valueType.{notices.valueType.message, records.valueType.fields.valueType, refusals.valueType.message, screens.valueType.description, screens.valueType.title}` under `data.options[1].manifest`.
- `api/ListInstalledPackagesResponse` (+8): the same five under `data.packages.element.options[1].manifest`, plus `aiContexts.element.related.element.where.lazy.lazy`, `views.element.list.emptyState.link.url`, `views.element.list.grouping.fields.element.field`.

`measured.droppedRefinementSites` 1225 to 1239. A `patch` changeset covers the published `json-schema/api/*` annotation growth (`x-` keywords; no accepted document changes).

## Tests

`scripts/dropped-refinements.test.ts`, new `describe('the walk is bounded by identity, never by depth')`:
- a refinement 40 objects deep is reported at its full path;
- lit control: the same leaf one level deep is one site;
- a `lazy` getter returning a fresh node per call makes the census throw naming the export.

Ablation: the base version of `dropped-refinements.ts` restored on disk turns the deep and runaway pins red (2 failed / 28 passed), control stays green; restored byte-identical (`git hash-object` a6f5f824 = HEAD blob).

## Acceptance notes

- `refinementSitesThatDidProject` in the ledger header reads 728 while the build measures 812 at base and 830 now; no test reads that field. Left untouched (outside this card's file-surface rows).

## Verification

Read first: `packages/spec/scripts/lib/dropped-refinements.ts` (the walk loop and `RUNAWAY_WALK_DEPTH`), then the ledger diff.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec gen:schema` prints `1239 refinement site(s) across 281 published schema(s) ... all declared`, and `json-schema/api/InstalledPackageAtEitherStage.json` names `...records.valueType.fields.valueType` in `x-dropped-refinements`.
